overall_summary: Husband-wife/marriage relationship dynamics dramatically outperform other content types (1,600+ views vs <400 for generic family/shayari videos). Generic sister clips and abstract sad shayari show consistently low performance.

winning_patterns.evidence: Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya? (1,767 views, 61 likes) and Wife Emotional Video (1,674 views, 50 likes) are top performers.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on real-life marital emotional dynamics and unspoken expectations between partners.

winning_patterns.evidence: Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota reached 385 views, outperforming general life advice and single-person emotional quotes.
winning_patterns.action: Frame hooks around relatable relational conflict and quiet sacrifices.

weak_patterns.evidence: Jis Din Sach Likhunga... got only 19 views and 1 like.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic poetic lines without a grounded, real-life situational scenario.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister videos scored 19 views and 138 views, underperforming compared to parental or partner topics.
weak_patterns.action: Pause sibling-focused shorts unless tied to a unique relatable marital/adulthood life transition.
